title: El Nido Tranquilo, private pool, solar energy.

images.caption: Main bedroom with ensuite bathroom. King bed.

description: A perfect location for those who value quiet and cozy living. Located in a small valley, two miles from town center. Fully renovated home with a private pool, El Nido Tranquilo allows you to live like a local, work remotely, and appreciate the tropical life outside of the crowds. The house has everything one needs to settle in for a longer-term rental. WiFi (500 Mbps), 3 bedrooms, 2 bath, large yard, and almost unheard neighbors. Driving in from the main road feels like a short adventure.The spaceEL Nido Tranquilo is a respite in all ways. Modern, new, and stocked with amenities for daily life and island-living in a truly tranquil environment amongst one of Puerto rico's most popular travel destinations. Located in Calvache, the home is surrounded hill views, open skies, and quiet roads. It is just a few miles outside of Rincón's more populated neighborhoods and still has easy, quick access to shorelines, conveniences like groceries, and local attractions. The open living room and kitchen are filled with natural light during the day. AC, a streaming 65” TV, and a lounge-worthy sofa make for perfect movie nights. The fully-equipped kitchen and dining area have enough place settings for 6 people. A blender, coffee maker, and full array of cooking utensils are available for use. Filtered water is available from the refrigerator. Each bedroom has AC, natural light, a premium mattresses, and clothes storage. Bedroom 1: a king bed, en suite bathroom, and TV. Bedroom 2: a queen bed Bedroom 3: two twin beds that can be converted into one large bed. Outside, the 8’ x 19’ pool offers shaded relaxation under its built-in umbrella on a shallow Sundeck and sunny swimming in the deeper end. Beach towels and beach chairs are provided. An outdoor shower and 2 foot-rinse stations help guests keep their space free of sand. The closest beach is just a 5-minute drive out of the hills. Surf spots are 10 minutes away. Aguada and Aguadilla surf breaks are within 15-30 minutes.Guest accessEntire private home & yard.Other things to noteSolar & energy conservation: Please turn off any ACS and lights when departing for the day and/or upon check out. All windows & doors must be closed when using AC. Pool care: the pool gets serviced 1/week. However, if you notice anything off about the pool between services (changing color, noisy machinery), please report to management immediately. Please kindly ensure all trash placed in the municipal bin is in closed bags. Loose trash will not be collected and will attract island wildlife. We ask guests to remember that they are on a tropical island. From time to time, there will be insects or an occasional gecko who makes its way into the house. Iguanas will be seen roaming outside. This is simply part of island life.All items in the garage are owner’s property. They are not to be used, moved, or touched. The AC in the main bedroom takes about 20 seconds to turn off. Please be patient with it.Please do no throw large amounts of paper in the toilets. Absolutely no other items in the toilets besides paper. Please do not pour grease into the kitchen sink. Excessive paper and oils will cause the septic to clog.
